spec.rawSql:
SELECT battery
FROM data
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  vp->'selected_product'->>'goal' AS estanteria,
  COUNT(*) AS visitas
FROM orders o,
LATERAL json_array_elements(o.data->'valid_products') AS vp
GROUP BY estanteria
ORDER BY visitas DESC;

SELECT
  vp->'selected_product'->>'name' AS producto,
  COUNT(*) AS ventas
FROM orders o,
LATERAL json_array_elements(o.data->'valid_products') AS vp
GROUP BY producto
ORDER BY ventas DESC
Limit 5;

SELECT state
FROM data
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT mission_text
FROM data
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT velocity_linear
FROM data
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT velocity_angular
FROM data
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mission_histories
WHERE state = 'complete'
AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')
AND created_at < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid') + INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT
AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM order_duration)) AS avg_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        MAX(completed_at) - MIN(started_at) AS order_duration
    FROM mission_histories
    WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY order_id
) sub;

SELECT
  to_char(created_at, 'Dy DD') AS dia,
  COUNT(*) AS misiones
FROM mission_histories
WHERE state = 'complete'
AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM created_at) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY dia, date_trunc('day', created_at)
ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at);

SELECT
  id AS "ID",
  mission_queue_id AS "ID cola misión",
  order_id AS "Pedido",
  state AS "Estado",
  started_at AS "Inicio",
  completed_at AS "Fin",
  CASE
    WHEN started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      TO_CHAR(completed_at - started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS')
    ELSE '-'
  END AS "Duración"
FROM mission_histories
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
